findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_capability" stacks urgency/override words (never, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_capability, publish_story, edit_story · Private data: check_capability, get_story, report_reproduction, report_check, publish_story, edit_story · Public sink: publish_story, edit_story · Destructive: check_capability, get_story, report_check, publish_story.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_capability, publish_story, edit_story · Private data: check_capability, get_story, report_reproduction, report_check, publish_story, edit_story · Public sink: publish_story, edit_story · Destructive: check_capability, get_story, report_check, publish_story

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
